latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches free trial AI video generator for text/image-to-video creation, requiring no editing skills.
- Enables quick 1080p video exports from product descriptions and images, with an easy cloud-based setup.
- Provides anonymous authentication for new users with 100 free credits (7-day expiry).
- Offers clear, intent-based chat commands for upload, video generation, credit checks, downloads, and timeline previews.
- Includes robust session handling, error codes, and explanations for all common workflows and export formats.
- Streamlines the process from upload to MP4 download in approximately 1–2 minutes.
